title: Complete Quotation printing and validity governance
description: Implement the audited Quotation gaps that do not require a production schema change: quotation print endpoint/configuration, print preview/direct print/design registration, validity-due visibility/reminder using the existing quotation validity data, and quotation conversion-rate reporting on the existing report framework.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/sales/quotations/{id}/print exists and uses the same authoritative totals/details as the Quotation workflow.
Quotation is registered in the shared bill print configuration so preview, direct print and print design work from the UI.
Quotation validity status/due reminder is visible without adding a production schema dependency.
A quotation conversion-rate report is available through the existing report framework with documented calculation rules.
Unit/integration tests cover print data, validity classification and conversion-rate calculations; existing safe validation remains green.
Real Edge acceptance covers quotation preview/print entry points and validity/report visibility with no JS/API errors.

scenarios: Open a quotation, preview/print it and verify the rendered header/detail/total data.
Verify an expired or near-due quotation is classified visibly by the validity governance UI.
Open the quotation conversion report and verify it loads without JS/API errors.

human_gate.reason: No production schema/deployment action is required.
